In 143 (70.4%) ICUs, Griggs guide wire dilatation forceps (GWDF) was being used as the first choice of EPT technique. The number and percentage of ICUs using bronchoscopy and ultra- sonography (USG) as a guide was only 49 (24.1%) and 20 (9.9%) ICUs respectively (Table 2). The usage of EPT and elective surgical tracheotomy (EST) was often being decided by the ICU team (182 ICUs, 89.7%; 173 ICUs, 85.2% respectively).
